name: Continue to TOTP Confirmation
summary: After configuring an authenticator from the displayed enrollment material, the user continues to the verification-code view without invoking another server operation.

preconditions.expression: user is authenticated and TOTP enrollment material has already been staged

serverInteraction.intent: Navigate to confirmation without regenerating or replacing the staged authenticator secret.

postconditions.expression: the same staged TOTP enrollment remains pending and TOTP is not yet enabled

sourceReferences.note: Continue is a navigation-only scenario. Entering the confirm view must not call BeginTotpEnrollment again.
